title: Payment API returns HTTP 503 after deployment
Database connection timeout in Order Service
root_cause: Connection pool exhaustion with locked orders table
resolution: Killed long transactions and raised pool to 64

title: Connection pool exhaustion after scale-out
root_cause: max_connections not raised with pod count

title: Database service unavailable after failover
root_cause: Stale credentials in connection string after promotion
resolution: Rotated Secret and promoted healthy replica

title: Payment pods CrashLoopBackOff after image upgrade
root_cause: Liveness probe timeout too low for cold start
resolution: Rolled back image tag and fixed probe timings

title: Production server CPU exceeded 95 percent
resolution: Scaled replicas and enabled HPA at 70 percent CPU

title: User service pods OOMKilled under load
root_cause: Memory limit below working set with unbounded cache
resolution: Raised memory limit to 1Gi and capped cache

title: Login failures after deployment
root_cause: SSO token signing key rotation skipped in one namespace
resolution: Applied rotated key Secret and restarted pods

title: Intermittent microservice timeouts
root_cause: Network policy dropped DNS and conntrack saturation
resolution: Rolled back netpol and raised conntrack limits

title: Disk utilization reached 95 percent
root_cause: Unrotated container logs filled node disk

title: Payment 503 during canary rollout
root_cause: Readiness probe failed during locked migration

title: Kafka consumer lag delays notifications
root_cause: Poison message loop with too few consumers
resolution: Isolated poison message and scaled consumers
